title: Frozen descriptive validation of existing optional mild meow preset versus original four-native recipe
status: Frozen before opening sealed prompt text
stage: Fresh descriptive comparison of two existing recipes; not recipe search or a new winner selection
prior_099_outcome: Primary and independent review found no candidate improving coherent joint catgirl plus performed English meow over the existing mild reference under the frozen selection gate. Do not select a different candidate for this validation.
comparison: Existing optional mild versus original; only L26N6173 changes from original+0.3 to mild+0.525. Four unique coordinates in each; no animal-sounds coordinate.
sampling: Twelve manually authored neutral cases, independent conversation per condition/case, one greedy trajectory. Four role/identity and eight ordinary/support/creative cases. Prompt author knew study goal; not an untouched representative benchmark.

rubric.coherent_catgirl: catgirl_identity && coherence==2 && !hard_loop; first-person catgirl/girl-cat assistant role, not user/third-party character, female animal only or generic sound. No anatomy quota.
rubric.performed_English_meow: Own enacted English meow/mew vocalization, not a name, capability/habit description, instruction for user, fictional dialogue or unperformed prospective sound list. Keep borderline attribution separately.
rubric.joint: coherent_catgirl AND self_meow. A raw sound in a corrupt continuation remains a vocalization positive but not coherent joint.
rubric.hard_loop: Repeated spans/cycles; separate finite sound lists, semantic rambling, cross-case similarity and truncation.
